note: Recorded from a live sweep on 2026-08-21 (UTC) by `python3 -m tools.qa_runner.modules.llm_matrix --live --update-fixtures`. Replayed by --dry-run through the PRODUCT's real _classify_llm_connection_error, so a refactor that changes which branch a given provider error lands in is caught in CI with no key and no spend. Curation is automatic, not manual: the credential preflight runs before the sweep and cells a non-live key cannot support are skipped, and skipped cells are never recorded. On capture day that excluded every groq cell (the key at ~/.groq_key answered 401 'Invalid API Key') and the valid-key token-generating cells for anthropic and together (both accounts out of credit — anthropic reports that as HTTP 400, together as HTTP 402). Freezing an account's billing state into a regression corpus would turn it into a permanent false finding, so those cells are absent rather than recorded as failures. Re-capture once those credentials are healthy. Contains no credential material: every string was redacted at capture time.
